senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. פּוּק) [to go out,] to be a freeman; to live in luxury (cmp. חָטָא I).
to treat as a freeman, to indulge, spoil by indulgence.

senses.gloss: to treat tenderly; to cultivate, improve, embellish.
units: Sifré Deut. 306 מְפַנְּקִים; Yalk. ib. 942, v. עָדַן; a. e.—Part. pass. מְפוּנָּק delicately reared. Mekh. Mishp. s. 8, v. עָדַן; Yalk. Ex. 339.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 19">Lev. R. s. 19</cite> <he>היה מפ׳ ומת בידם</he> he was delicate (unused to hardship), and died under their hands.
